tagline.zh: 多选控件:一组里可同时选中任意多项;配一个全选框时,「部分选中」用 indeterminate 半选态表达。
tagline.en: A multi-select control: any number of siblings can be checked at once; with a select-all, the 'some selected' state is expressed as an indeterminate half-check.

origin.zh: 原生 <input type="checkbox"> 即 APG checkbox 模式;第三态经 aria-checked="mixed" 表达(Carbon 数据表格的表头全选同为三态,调研 07§6/§13)。生产参照系是 Ant Design Checkbox(antd 6.7.1 核对:checked 默认 false、indeterminate 默认 false 且只控样式、disabled 默认 false、Group 的 value/defaultValue 默认 [],见设计调研 06§4.8)。
origin.en: The native <input type="checkbox"> already implements the APG checkbox pattern; the third state is expressed via aria-checked="mixed" (Carbon's data-table header select-all is tristate too, research 07 §6/§13). The production reference is Ant Design Checkbox (checked against antd 6.7.1: checked defaults false, indeterminate defaults false and is style-only, disabled false, Group value/defaultValue default [] — design study 06 §4.8).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 双向:面板改动驱动三个子项,点击子项也回写本参数)。对应「全选框」的勾选态——全部子项选中时为 on、否则 off;「部分选中」是派生的半选态(aria-checked="mixed"),不落在本参数里(antd indeterminate 默认 false 且只控样式,06§4.8)。
effect.en: JS-type param (two-way in the demo: panel edits drive the three children, child clicks write back). Represents the select-all checkbox state — on only when every child is checked, else off; 'some selected' is a derived indeterminate state (aria-checked="mixed") and does not live in this param (antd indeterminate defaults false and is style-only, 06 §4.8).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切 data-disabled)。对齐 antd Checkbox 的 disabled:默认 false(06§4.8);组级 disabled 同时禁用全选框与全部子项(antd Checkbox.Group 同样提供整组 disabled)。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles data-disabled). Aligns with antd Checkbox disabled, default false (06 §4.8); a group-level disabled disables the select-all and all children together (antd Checkbox.Group offers the same group-level disabled).

note.zh: 原生 checkbox 的键盘(Space)与读屏支持全平台完备;半选态有两套通道——原生 input.indeterminate DOM 属性(视觉打点)与 aria-checked="mixed"(读屏播报),两者应同时设置,缺一则视觉与播报不同步。
note.en: Native checkboxes ship complete keyboard (Space) and screen-reader support everywhere; the half state has two channels — the native input.indeterminate DOM property (visual dash) and aria-checked="mixed" (announced state) — both must be set, or visuals and announcements desync.

fallback.zh: 无 JS 时原生表单照常工作;全选联动的派生逻辑不可用时,保留「全选框 + 子项」的静态表单语义即可——浏览器原生表单提交不依赖 JS。
fallback.en: Without JS native forms keep working; if the select-all derivation is unavailable, the static semantics of 'select-all + children' still hold — native form submission never needed JS.

use.zh: 「全选 + 子项」批量场景:列表行首勾选、购物车合并结算、批量操作(调研 07§13 Carbon 数据表格的三态全选)
use.en: 'Select-all + children' batch scenarios: list row checks, cart consolidation, bulk actions (research 07 §13 Carbon data-table tristate select-all)

use.zh: 互不排斥的多选项:订阅渠道、权限点、筛选条件
use.en: Non-exclusive multi-picks: subscription channels, permission points, filter conditions

use.zh: 「我已阅读并同意」类确认勾选(单框形态)
use.en: 'I have read and agree' confirmation checks (single-box form)

avoid.zh: 即时生效的二元设置——用 switch;checkbox 勾选后通常要等「提交」才生效,两种心智不能混(调研 07§6)
avoid.en: Instant-effect binary settings — use a switch; a checkbox usually waits for submit, and the two mental models must not mix (research 07 §6)

avoid.zh: 互斥单选——用 radio group;勾选框允许全不选,表达不了「必选其一」约束
avoid.en: Exclusive single choice — use a radio group; checkboxes allow none selected and cannot express 'exactly one'

avoid.zh: 只靠视觉打点表达半选而漏设 aria-checked="mixed"——读屏会把它读成未选中
avoid.en: Expressing the half state only via the visual dash while omitting aria-checked="mixed" — screen readers will announce it as unchecked

avoid.zh: 勾选后即时执行删除等不可逆操作——勾选只是选择,执行前需要明确的动作按钮确认
avoid.en: Triggering irreversible actions (delete) immediately on check — checking is a selection; execution needs an explicit action button

a11y.zh: 组语义用 fieldset/legend(或 role=group + aria-labelledby)命名;全选框在部分选中时设 input.indeterminate=true + aria-checked="mixed";键盘 Space 切换(WebAIM 键位表,调研 07§36);disabled 用原生属性并在文案中说明原因;勾选框与文字标签整体可点(label 包裹),命中区≥ 控件本身。
a11y.en: Group semantics come from fieldset/legend (or role=group + aria-labelledby); the select-all sets input.indeterminate=true + aria-checked="mixed" when partially selected; Space toggles (WebAIM key table, research 07 §36); disabled uses the native attribute with the reason stated in copy; the hit area covers the label text too (label wraps the input), never smaller than the control itself.

goal.zh: 复刻「全选 + 三子项」多选组:fieldset/legend 命名,全选框在部分选中时呈现 indeterminate 半选,勾选任一子项即时联动全选态,支持整组 disabled。
goal.en: Replicate a 'select-all + three children' checkbox group: fieldset/legend naming, a select-all showing an indeterminate half-check when partially selected, instant two-way linkage from any child, and a group-wide disabled.

acceptance.zh: 全选联动为双向派生:子项全选中→全选 on;全不选→off;其余→indeterminate(视觉打点 + aria-checked="mixed" 同时设置)
acceptance.en: Select-all linkage is a two-way derivation: all children on → select-all on; none → off; otherwise indeterminate (visual dash + aria-checked="mixed" set together)

acceptance.zh: 组语义经 fieldset/legend 提供;键盘 Space 切换为原生 checkbox 行为
acceptance.en: Group semantics via fieldset/legend; Space toggling is native checkbox behavior

acceptance.zh: disabled 同时禁用全选与子项并整体减淡;选中底色 #1677ff(antd colorPrimary),圆角 4px(borderRadiusSM)
acceptance.en: disabled disables select-all and children together and dims the group; checked fill #1677ff (antd colorPrimary), radius 4px (borderRadiusSM)

acceptance.zh: 控件尺寸 16px(antd controlInteractiveSize = controlHeight/2),点击区域覆盖文字标签
acceptance.en: Control size 16px (antd controlInteractiveSize = controlHeight/2); the hit area covers the text label too

acceptance.zh: selectAll 参数与面板双向同步;无布局抖动,半选态切换不改变行高
acceptance.en: The selectAll param syncs both ways with the panel; no layout shift — the half state never changes line height
